caseName: Hemmerle v. First Federal Savings & Loan Ass'n
caseNameFull: Hemmerle et ux. v. First Federal Savings & Loan Association of DeSoto County

opinions.text: Appeal from Dist. Ct. App. Fla., 2d Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
